description: Before holding or accepting one stablecoin in size: 90-day daily and 7-day hourly peg history (worst print, days off peg), supply rank and 1/7/30-day mint and redemption flows, chain split, peers, every risk component explained, plain-English summary. coin = ticker, name or CoinGecko id (default USDe). PAID: $0.04 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/stablecoins/report.
